unit: one task and one arm with a fresh generation context; 2 planned pairs, 4 planned arm tasks

first_attempt.seal: Before evaluation or feedback, record full submission or missing result, source digests, exit status and observed usage.
first_attempt.pass: Every original applicable automatic and blind manual obligation must pass with artifact-bound evidence, and shared rules/input conformance must pass as a separate experiment condition.
first_attempt.denominator: Report outcomes out of all four planned arm tasks, two per arm; pair effects use eligible complete pairs and disclose missing or excluded pairs separately.

defects.unit: One reproducible root cause per task/arm/attempt, linked to all affected rubric checks; recurrence under seeds or repeats is not another defect.
defects.handling: Preserve first evidence, input, expected/observed behavior and source digest. Missing evidence stays NOT_EVALUATED; supervisor or environment errors are not candidate defects.

repair.admission: Only after attempt 1 is sealed and evaluated. One extra attempt with the same feedback format, public reproducer only, no hidden expected trace or opposite-arm output.
repair.attribution: Track candidate retry and supervisor intervention separately. A supervisor source patch invalidates the affected arm-task for any model-only repair estimate and stays as an engineering observation.
repair.unknown: Unavailable usage is null with reason. Record actual counts separately from declared limits. Missing provider telemetry prevents claims of hard-budget equivalence, monetary cost, or token savings.
repair.final: Report first and final outcomes side by side, and repairs per all planned arm tasks and per attempted repair. Report paired observations descriptively; no inference from replay counts or historical candidates.
